svg.title: Libya in spring 2011: the east had broken away
svg.desc: Situation map covering 8.7°E to 25.8°E, 18.9°N to 34.2°N. Schematic · approximate, First Libyan Civil War ~spring 2011 (after UNSCR 1973) · open-source reporting, not operational intelligence. Areas of control in 3 classes: Gaddafi loyalists, Rebels / NTC, Contested (oil crescent) (contested). Marked: Contested / besieged (approx.). Schematic polygons drawn by hand from open-source reporting of the 2011 uprising, not a geocoded dataset. Every zone is drawn as assessed control from open-source reporting; no claimed-only or reported-only ground is shown separately. Open-source reporting, First Libyan Civil War; Natural Earth basemap. As of ~1 April 2011 · illustrative, not an operational assessment. 6 mapped features can be reached with the Tab key, each one naming what it is. The map draws the assessment it was given; it does not verify who holds what.

path.aria-label: Gaddafi loyalists, 51% of the mapped area
Rebels / NTC, 48% of the mapped area
Contested (oil crescent), 1% of the mapped area
